info.title: AmbatuMove Core API
info.description: Workout planning, activity tracking, catalog, gym directory, and calorie estimates. All payloads are synthetic examples; calorie values are estimates. Planner generation and adaptation apply PLANNER_MAX_GENERATION_MS and return HTTP 504 with PLANNER_TIMEOUT on deadline. Forwarded client identity is honored only from TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS.

request.summary: Mixed bodyweight and outdoor walking session

post.summary: Generate a weekly or multi-week program

get.summary: Search gyms by location, equipment, and facilities

parameters.name: equipment
parameters.description: Repeatable canonical equipment ID; all filters apply

parameters.name: facility
parameters.description: Repeatable facility ID; all filters apply

post.summary: Submit a gym or factual correction for moderation
Approve or reject a gym submission (admin)

get.summary: Estimate calories with a MET formula

parameters.name: activity
parameters.description: Activity category when no ID is used

parameters.name: weight_kg
parameters.description: Body mass or signed-in profile default

post.summary: Estimate calories for timed workout segments

patch.summary: Update editable workout status with version check

post.summary: Adapt saved workout with version check

200.description: Sessions, minutes, volume, and activity counts

post.summary: Adapt upcoming sessions in a saved program

patch.summary: Move a future workout to a rest day

200.description: The contract used by the runtime API docs

get.summary: Recommend activities for a calorie target
get.description: Stateless gross MET estimate. Required duration is rounded up to a whole minute; each returned estimate is recalculated at its recommended (possibly capped) duration. Results are deterministically ordered, and partial alternatives are returned when the target cannot be met within the maximum duration.

parameters.name: weight_kg
parameters.description: Body mass in kilograms; no profile weight is inferred for this stateless public endpoint.

parameters.name: max_duration_minutes
parameters.description: Maximum activity duration; defaults to 180 minutes.

parameters.name: available_equipment
parameters.description: Repeat for each available equipment ID. Without gym_id, omission or an explicitly empty list permits bodyweight/no-required-equipment activities only; provide IDs to allow equipment. With gym_id, omission uses the gym inventory and an explicit list is intersected with it.

parameters.name: excluded_equipment
parameters.description: Repeat equipment IDs that must not be used.

parameters.name: gym_id
parameters.description: Use the active recorded inventory for this gym; unknown gyms return 404.

200.description: Ordered compatible recommendations, including partial alternatives when available.

recommendations.name: Outdoor Walking
recommendations.reason: Compatible with the supplied activity constraints; the target is not reached within the available duration.

data.disclaimer: Calorie expenditure values are estimates; actual expenditure varies between individuals and conditions.

400.description: Missing, malformed, duplicated, unsupported, or out-of-range query parameters.

401.description: Invalid supplied bearer or partner credentials.

403.description: Supplied credentials do not authorize the requested partner scope.

429.description: Public or partner request rate exceeded.
